channel.title: Sloth Jam news
channel.description: News from Sloth Jam, the free cozy party game for the whole family.

item.title: The Cosmic Islands: fly from the Moon to five little planets
item.description: A Star Portal on the Moon now opens a map of five little round planets to run all the way around. Here is how to get there, how to open each planet and what to do on them.

item.title: Meet the Wildlings: 18 little friends to find in Sloth Jam
item.description: Wildlings are little creatures you make friends with, never catch. There are 18 now, five of them new on the Cosmic Islands. Here is where each one lives and how to befriend it.

item.title: Sloth Jam is free, family friendly, and has no loot boxes
item.description: Sloth Jam is free to play, made for ages 6 and up, and has no loot boxes and no pay to win. A new page for parents explains how rewards work.

item.title: Sloth Jam now has 64 one-minute party games
item.description: Sloth Jam now has 64 party games. Every one lasts one minute and plays with one stick and one button, with no reading needed.

item.title: Sloth Jam is now on Google Play for Android
item.description: Sloth Jam is live on Google Play, so Android devices can install the free cozy party game from the store.

item.title: Sloth Jam is on the Amazon Appstore for Fire tablets
item.description: Sloth Jam is live on the Amazon Appstore, so families with an Amazon Fire tablet can install the free cozy party game.

item.title: New on the island: glowing caves, Vikings, a pirate ship and more
item.description: The Sloth Jam island grew a lot this month: caves under the island, a Viking village, a pirate ship, a coaster train, a beach cape, kart races, pets to adopt and animals to play as. Here is where to find each one.
